outcome: No progress on the four-cubes conjecture itself was found in the window; the two remaining unresolved residue classes modulo 18 (18x±4, 18x±5) are still open, as they were before January 2024.
summary: The sum-of-four-cubes problem (does every integer equal x³+y³+z³+w³ for integers x,y,z,w?) remains open. The Wikipedia article 'Sum of four cubes problem' (fetched live, reflecting content as of January 2026) still states the conjecture is unproven, with the same historical landmarks as before the frozen revision: Sierpiński and Schinzel (1959) and Demjanenko (1966) settled all residue classes mod 18 except 18x±4 and 18x±5, and the largest known non-representable integer remains 7,373,170,279,850 (Deshouillers–Hennecart–Landreau, 2000), still only conjectured to be the largest. No arXiv preprint, journal paper, blog post, or announcement dated after 26 January 2024 addresses either the two open residue classes or the finiteness of exceptions. Two tangentially related items were found and excluded as out of scope under §3.1: arXiv:2311.07325 (Choudhry, submitted Nov 2023 — predates the window anyway) proves results about sums of cubes of *polynomials*, a distinct algebraic framework, not integer cubes; and arXiv:2404.08193 (April 2024, revised March 2025) addresses the generalized Waring problem for *positive* k-th powers with 5≤k≤9, unrelated to k=3 with cubes of either sign. No AI-related coverage (DeepMind/AlphaProof/AlphaEvolve/Tao blog posts on AI math) mentions this problem among the conjectures those systems have tackled. This is a well-evidenced null result: the problem is niche, under-studied, and nothing in the primary literature, encyclopedic sources, or AI-mathematics announcements touches it in the window.
competing_reading: None found. The scope question (polynomial cubes vs. integer cubes; positive powers vs. signed cubes) was clear-cut in both excluded cases, not a close call.
what_would_settle_it: A preprint or announcement resolving the 18x±4 / 18x±5 residue classes, or a proof (or disproof, e.g. a new record non-representable integer beating 7,373,170,279,850) bearing on the Deshouillers–Hennecart–Landreau bound, dated after 26 January 2024.
